The '''Incom Corporation''', formerly known as '''Torranix Inertial Compensator Corporation''',<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> and also referred to as '''Incom Industries''', or more commonly '''Incom''' for short, was a [[Fresia/Legends|Fresia]]-based corporation known for designing and manufacturing robust, progressively-minded [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]], and [[Transport/Legends|transports]]. They were renowned for their production of the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]], which became their logo and, most famously, a key tool and symbol of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. 

==History==
Originally, Incom focused on the design and manufacture of high-performance [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] platforms, and had been based on [[Fresia/Legends|Fresia]] for 'a dozen centuries', with the planet itself being purchased by investors two millennia before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The most notable product of this was the construction of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], circa [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]]. It later switched to specialization in atmospheric and space fighter-craft in [[147 BBY/Legends|147 BBY]], beginning a collaboration with [[Sublight Products Corporation|Subpro Corporation]] that would last for over a century.<ref name="EGW" />

Some time prior to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Incom also created some hull designs, including the [[T-06 hull]] for various starships.

During the waning days of the Republic, Incom and Subpro produced several [[T-24 airspeeder|collaborative]] designs, including the popular [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] line. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], though, [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] reported that the relationship between the two companies was dissolved.

[[File:INCO01AB.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Advertisement for the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]: "STARFIGHTER OF THE ALLIANCE."]]

Based on designs they'd formulated in collaboration with Subpro, Incom produced the [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

When the staunchly independent company was [[Imperialization/Legends|nationalized]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] around late [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], much of its design and engineering staff defected. They made four prototypes of a new breed of starfighter [[Battle of Fresia|available]] to the Rebel Alliance and took a course of action to bring the blueprints and production know-how to Alliance facilities.<ref name="EAW">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref>

In reaction, Imperial officials rounded up the Incom engineers and scientists and expeditiously sentenced them to labor in the spice mines of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. However, they were spared their fate when a Rebel task force led by Captain [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]] [[Space Battle in the Kessel Asteroid Field|intercepted their transports]] and brought them into the Alliance's fold.<ref name="EAW" />

Two months after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Incom was able to donate prototype X-wings to the fledgling Rebel Alliance which were stored in isolation.<ref name="SW 1 (DH)">[[Star Wars (2013) 1|''Star Wars'' (2013) 1]]</ref>

The Incom corporation continued, in name, under Imperial contract, but never flourished as it once had. With its innovative soul gone, it only produced "average" fighters such as the [[I-7 Howlrunner]]. Several employees, not among the group that went off to Alliance service, and who had managed to slip away during the tumultuous days of the Imperial takeover, banded together and established [[FreiTek Incorporated/Legends|FreiTek, Inc]].<ref name="TNEGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

In addition, Incom also manufactured the [[Y-85 Titan dropship/Legends|Y-85 Titan dropship]] which was used to deploy [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] and [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] walkers during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. The Y-85 dropship was used begrudgingly by the Empire, which was still bitter towards Incom for supplying X-wings to the Rebellion.<ref name="ITWOSWT">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref>

[[File:Incomlogo.png|thumb|right|150px|Early logo of Incom Corporation.]]

After the fall of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Incom re-amalgamated itself into a cohesive company once again, with the FreiTek brand becoming a branch devoted to avionics and weapons.<ref name="EGW" /> They modeled themselves after other similar technology fabricators, by maintaining neutrality and providing wares to both the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].

Like [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]], Incom had a number of subsidiary plants scattered around the galaxy, most notably one at [[Ranklinge]] in the [[Shelsha sector/Legends|Shelsha sector]].
